methods.description: Lists all connections detected by Page Shield.

props.name: zone_id
props.description: Identifier

props.name: direction
props.description: The direction used to sort returned connections.

props.name: exclude_cdn_cgi
props.description:
When true, excludes connections seen in a `/cdn-cgi` path from the
returned connections. The default value is true.

props.name: exclude_urls
props.description:
Excludes connections whose URL contains one of the URL-encoded URLs
separated by commas.

props.name: export
props.description: Export the list of connections as a file, limited to 50000 entries.

props.name: hosts
props.description:
Includes connections that match one or more URL-encoded hostnames
separated by commas.

Wildcards are supported at the start and end of each hostname to support starts
with, ends with and contains. If no wildcards are used, results will be filtered
by exact match

props.name: order_by
props.description: The field used to sort returned connections.

props.name: page
props.description:
The current page number of the paginated results.

We additionally support a special value "all". When "all" is used, the API will
return all the connections with the applied filters in a single page. This
feature is best-effort and it may only work for zones with a low number of
connections

props.name: page_url
props.description:
Includes connections that match one or more page URLs (separated by
commas) where they were last seen

Wildcards are supported at the start and end of each page URL to support starts
with, ends with and contains. If no wildcards are used, results will be filtered
by exact match

props.name: per_page
props.description: The number of results per page.

props.name: prioritize_malicious
props.description:
When true, malicious connections appear first in the returned
connections.

props.name: status
props.description:
Filters the returned connections using a comma-separated list of
connection statuses. Accepted values: `active`, `infrequent`, and `inactive`.
The default value is `active`.

props.name: urls
props.description:
Includes connections whose URL contain one or more URL-encoded URLs
separated by commas.

url host and zone hostname. In such case, we return the most recent script for
the URL host and zone hostname combination.
